messages:
maria: Kicking off a regional recovery bakeoff planning thread — want to lock owners + schedule for game day tests and follow-ups. Goal: validate multi-region routing, backup restores, and runbook clarity across EU/US/APAC.
ajay: +1. can we aim for a 2-week runway? need time for stateful restore dry-runs.
lina: I can own runbook refreshes (eu & apac). I’ll do a doc PR with checklists and expected recovery times.
kevin: I’ll take routing failover tests (traffic steering, BGP + app-layer fallbacks). Need a list of test endpoints and canary traffic scripts.
sam: I’ll do backups and restore verification across our 3-region S3 buckets and snapshotting in Dedicated clusters. Will instrument success/failure metrics.
incidents-bot: ACTION CREATED: #A-4523 "Bakeoff orchestration plan" assigned to maria, due 2024-11-08 :spiral_calendar: 
maria: Proposed owners summary:
• Runbooks: lina
• Routing: kevin
• Backups/restores: sam
• Orchestration + scheduling: maria

Can everyone ACK and add any sub-owners.
lina: ACK. sub-owner: harry for eu-west runbook steps (will ping him)
kevin: ACK. sub-owner: devops-runner svc account for running canary jobs.
sam: ACK. sub-owner: backup-ops (team) to validate snapshot restore perms.
ajay: Quick ask: can we add a recurring incident-pattern note? We keep seeing slow failover to warm-standby with elevated DNS TTLs — want to capture that as mitigation.
maria: Good call. Add "DNS TTL verification" to routing checklist and add a guardrail: TTL <= 60s for critical routes.
kevin: I’ll add a smoke-test script snippet. ```bash
# run from ci-agent
curl -H 'Host:api.redwood.example' https://router-test.internal/ping || echo FAIL
``` 
lina: Runbook draft checklist (short):
1) Confirm owner oncall
2) Verify latest backup timestamp
3) Execute permissioned restore to staging
4) Run smoke tests against restored instance
5) Promote DNS + traffic cutover steps
6) Postmortem capture template

maria: Timeline proposal:
• 2024-10-28: Runbook PRs merged
• 2024-11-04: Dry-run restores (staging)
• 2024-11-08: Routing canary + integrated smoke tests
• 2024-11-10: Full bakeoff (game day)

Can we make any dates earlier? I prefer giving teams a week each for signoffs.
sam: Dates look good. I’ll reserve backup windows and tag the snapshots accordingly.
ajay: Ops ask: please add ops-runbook play to the oncall rotation for the week of the game day so we get authorized responders.
oncall-bot: Scheduled oncall rotation add: week-of-2024-11-10 has extra DR play. Notifying rotation leads.
maria: Outstanding action items (short):
• lina -> PR runbook (due 2024-10-28)
• kevin -> canary scripts + TTL guardrail (due 2024-11-04)
• sam -> backup windows + snapshot perms check (due 2024-11-04)
• maria -> publish bakeoff runbook + calendar invites (due 2024-10-30)

Please update the tracking spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/dr-bakeoff (add rows for test cases).
kevin: Adding test case: "region pair failover (us->eu) with session affinity loss check".
lina: Adding test case: "restore with older schema - migration validation".
sam: Adding metric: "time-to-first-successful-restore" and target < 30m for critical datasets.
ajay: Also adding recurring pattern note: "slow DNS propagation during high control-plane load" — mitigation: staged propagation + health-check gating.
maria: Perfect. Let’s sync tomorrow 09:30 PT in #incidents for a 15m alignment. If no blockers, I’ll kick calendar invites.
kevin: I might be late but will post notes. :thumbsup: 
lina: Will have PR link by EOD.
sam: I’ll confirm snapshot perms by EOD as well.
incidents-bot: REMINDER in 24h: Action A-4523 due soon.
maria: Thanks all — we’ll capture follow-ups in the action tracker and close items post-game-day. If anything urgent pops up before tomorrow, DM me or ping @oncall.
